content.user_title: Build Better Vue and Nuxt Components
content.value_statement: Vue teams need consistent guidance for components, reactivity, and state flow. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 review rules.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Composition API defaults for Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 projects.
Guides ref, reactive, shallowRef, computed, and watcher usage.
Reviews Vue single-file component structure and template patterns.
Explains props, emits, v-model, provide, and inject data flow.
Compares composable stores, VueUse global state, and Pinia.
Encourages splitting large components into focused components and composables.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run project tests.
It assumes Vue 3 or Nuxt 3 and is not a Vue 2 migration guide.
It does not replace official framework documentation for version-specific changes.
Example snippets may need adaptation for each project architecture.

use_cases.title: Review a Vue component
use_cases.description: Check a component for reactivity mistakes, unclear data flow, and SFC structure issues.

use_cases.title: Standardize code reviews
use_cases.description: Use shared guidance when reviewing Nuxt components, composables, and state management choices.

use_cases.title: Guide generated Vue code
use_cases.description: Ask Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to apply Vue conventions before producing edits.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Vue 3 component for [feature]. Use Composition API, script setup, typed props, emits, and scoped styles.

prompt_templates.title: Review Reactivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Vue code for reactivity issues. Check ref, reactive, computed, watch, and async cleanup patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this parent and child component design. Use props, emits, v-model, or provide/inject where each choice fits.

prompt_templates.title: Design State Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a state management approach for this Vue or Nuxt feature. Compare composable stores, VueUse global state, and Pinia.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a review of a search component with watchers.
output_examples.output: Highlights missing request cleanup, recommends aborting stale requests, and suggests derived state through computed values.

output_examples.input: A team wants guidance for state sharing across several Nuxt pages.
output_examples.output: Explains when local props and emits are enough, when provide/inject helps, and when Pinia is a better fit.

output_examples.input: An assistant generated one large Vue component for a complex screen.
output_examples.output: Suggests focused child components, composables for stateful logic, and clearer SFC section organization.

best_practices: Use Composition API and typed script setup unless the project has another standard.
Keep source state minimal and derive values with computed properties.
Choose the smallest state sharing pattern that fits the feature.
anti_patterns: Do not store derived values in refs when computed values can express them.
Do not mix v-if and v-for on the same element.
Do not use a global store for short-lived component state.

faq.question: What projects does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Vue 3 and Nuxt 3 projects.

faq.question: Can it write Vue code?
faq.answer: It guides AI code generation and reviews. It does not execute code by itself.

faq.question: Does it require Pinia?
faq.answer: No. It recommends Pinia mainly for Nuxt, SSR, large apps, or features needing DevTools.

faq.question: Does it cover Vue single-file components?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers script setup, template patterns, slots, refs, attributes, and scoped styles.

faq.question: Can it help with performance?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes computed values, predictable state, focused components, and avoiding unnecessary render work.

faq.question: Is it safe for private code?
faq.answer: The skill is documentation-only. Review any AI tool configuration before sending private code to external services.
